question: Should agent-visible exec, process, and node-host results be redacted by default even when an existing workflow expects byte-exact command output?
rationale: The code has a coherent candidate implementation and real behavior evidence, but the tradeoff between preventing secret exposure and preserving exact command output is a persistent security/product contract that cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Adopt redacted-by-default output
options.body: Merge the current behavior, preserve the visible and structured redaction signals, and treat any raw-output mechanism as separately designed security work.

options.title: Define an explicit raw-output policy first
options.body: Pause this PR until owners specify whether a narrowly authorized raw-output capability is needed and how it avoids reintroducing secret exposure.

recommendation.title: Adopt redacted-by-default output
recommendation.body: Merge the current behavior, preserve the visible and structured redaction signals, and treat any raw-output mechanism as separately designed security work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the shared redaction behavior makes this the strongest available routing signal for the output-redaction contract.
